faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions. Still stuck? Create a ticket.

payouts.question: When are payouts processed?
payouts.answer: Payouts are processed on the 1st and 15th of every month for all completed deliveries, provided your payout method is verified.

coverage.question: How do I add or remove a coverage region?
coverage.answer: Go to Account → Business and update your coverage regions. Changes apply immediately to new delivery assignments.

policies.question: Where can I update my pricing or return policies?
policies.answer: Visit Settings → Policies to edit your pricing model, return handling, and damage policies at any time.

delay.question: What do I do if a delivery is delayed?
delay.answer: Update the delivery status from the Shipments page as soon as possible, and open a ticket if you need support coordinating with the vendor or customer.
